[[File:NanodroidScreen-Sabotage.png|thumb|right|200px|Nano-droids seen on a viewscreen]]
'''Nanotechnology''' was technology that operated on a nano scale. Typically molecular in size and nature, nanotechnology encompasses a great deal of technology, including [[nanogene droid]]s, [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]], [[nanotech]]s, and [[nanovirus]]es. Said microscopic machines were typically extremely expensive to manufacture, and almost always had a singular function. As a result nanotechnology, and nanites in general were limited to large corporations and medical firms, for use in changing molecular structures in both organics and inorganics alike.

[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] had developed nanotechnology, that enabled him to fuse [[Computer/Legends|computer]] intelligence into his [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] [[Mazariyan|citadel]] on [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]].<ref name="Boba Fett: A New Threat">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref>
